title: Lock Key Awakening
next_chapter_hook: "At the moment of breakthrough, Chen Ji sensed Ling Yuan's gaze piercing through the void, fixated on the three of them. That gaze was cold and profound, as if it had been waiting for a long time."

text.content: "In the dim stone chamber, charred paper scraps lay scattered across the floor. Chen Ji crouched before the remnants, his fingertips brushing across the final line of unfinished ink—'The true price of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key is...' Seven characters cut off mid-sentence, like a dull blade suspended over his heart. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul appeared on the first page of the Tianji Record, silver hair like snow, expression grave: 'Chen Ji, your sister's existence disrupts not just the foresight visions, but the entire causal chain of fate. When the three Lock Keys activate simultaneously...' His words cut off abruptly, for two sets of footsteps echoed outside the door—one light as wind, the other steady as a mountain."

dialogue.content: "Brother, I sensed it. That kind of call... it's like someone struck a drum deep within the bloodline."

text.content: "Chen Nian pushed open the door, her face pale yet eyes bright. Following closely behind was Chen Nian (Chen Year), his left arm still wrapped in bandages, but his gaze far more resolute than before. The three exchanged glances, and without words understood each other's purpose. Chen Ji stood up, tucking the burnt manuscript fragments into his sleeve, a meaningful curve forming at the corner of his mouth: 'Since you're all here, let's give it a try—what happens when the three Heavenly Fate Lock Keys activate simultaneously?'"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji, are you certain about this? There are records in demonic path scriptures about the consequences of Heavenly Fate Lock Key resonance... they cannot be predicted."

text.content: "Ye Qing leaned against the doorframe, demonic path mist swirling around her fingertips. She was someone Chen Ji had specially summoned—the energy fluctuations when Heavenly Fate Lock Keys activate are easily detected by the Eye of Heavenly Will, and her demonic path mist could conceal all of this. At this moment her brow was slightly furrowed, clearly harboring concerns about Chen Ji's risky endeavor. Yet Chen Ji merely glanced at her calmly, that gaze still as water, as if he had long since taken all variables into account: 'Precisely because it cannot be predicted, it is worth trying.'"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji, the true price of the Heavenly Fate Lock Keys... this old one should not tell you now, but seeing your demeanor, it seems impossible to stop you."

text.content: "Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul drifted slowly out from the pages of the book, a rare hesitation appearing on his aged face. He gazed at Chen Ji, Chen Nian, and Chen Nian (Chen Year), as if seeing shadows of someone from many years ago. After a long while, he spoke in a low voice: 'Each Heavenly Fate Lock Key seals away a portion of the user's Heavenly Fate. Every time it activates, the seal loosens a fraction. When three activate simultaneously... what you lose will be far more than cultivation level or lifespan.' Ye Qing's delicate body shuddered at his words, her demonic path mist nearly losing control: 'It's not just those things?' Mo Xiansheng did not answer, merely shifting his gaze to Chen Ji—those eyes held both expectation and deep worry."

choice.prompt: "Chen Ji must make a choice: activate the three Heavenly Fate Lock Keys immediately to pursue the truth, or first question Mo Xiansheng about the details of the price?"

choices.description: "Since the price is unavoidable, better to strike first before the Eye of Heavenly Will notices, seizing the initiative."
choices.visible_cost: "May lose part of Heavenly Fate or memories"
choices.visible_reward: "First realization of interference with Tianji Record foresight, breaking fate control"
choices.risk_hint: "Mo Xiansheng hesitated to speak, the price may exceed expectations"

text.content: "Chen Ji did not ask further. He looked at Chen Nian and Chen Nian (Chen Year), their gazes meeting in the air, understanding reached without words. Chen Nian was the first to extend her right hand, a faint golden Heavenly Fate mark appearing in her palm. Chen Nian (Chen Year) followed immediately, the bandages on his left arm dissolving into ash under the surge of True Qi, revealing an equally brilliant mark beneath. As for Chen Ji, he slowly翻开 the Tianji Record fragment, golden text beginning to burn of its own accord, transforming into three beams of light that respectively entered the three people's brow centers."

"In that instant, the entire stone chamber shook violently. Three golden pillars of light shot skyward, interweaving mid-air into a massive phantom wheel of fate. Ye Qing's demonic path mist surged explosively, enveloping the entire building, yet her face turned deathly pale—she was unleashing the strongest concealment of her life. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul let out a low sigh: 'It has begun...'"

choices.description: "First clarify the full scope of the price, then decide whether the risk is worth taking—Chen Ji never wages battles without certainty."
choices.risk_hint: "The Eye of Heavenly Will may detect the aura of the three Lock Keys in proximity at any moment"

text.content: "Chen Ji raised his hand, stopping Chen Nian who was about to activate her bloodline. He turned to Mo Xiansheng, his gaze sharp as a blade: 'Since Senior knows the price, why not say it earlier? Say it now, everything.' Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment, his remnant soul trembling intensely: 'Because this price... is related to your origins.'"

dialogue.content: "The true price of the Heavenly Fate Lock Keys is your Heavenly Fate. The instant the three Lock Keys resonate, your fates will merge, and then... half will be devoured by the Tianji Record."

text.content: "The excruciating pain of bloodline resonance crashed over Chen Ji like a tide. He felt his soul torn into countless fragments, then reassembled anew in chaos. He saw Chen Nian's memories—that little girl taken away by the Holy Sect, shivering in a lightless dungeon, yet always clutching an old copper coin, the protective talisman Chen Ji had given her in childhood. He also saw Chen Nian (Chen Year's) memories—the youth hunting demonic path cultivators alone, blood staining his robes, solely to gather news of his sister's whereabouts. Three sets of memories intertwined, three portions of Heavenly Fate began resonating."

dialogue.content: "Brother... I'm so scared. But as long as I'm with you, I'm not afraid of anything."

text.content: "Chen Nian's voice pierced through the chaos, clearly reaching Chen Ji's heart. He snapped back to awareness, realizing that the three people's consciousness had become completely linked at this moment. The Heavenly Fate marks on all three foreheads lit up simultaneously, golden light transforming the entire stone chamber into a sacred realm. Ye Qing was forced back several steps by this force, yet gritted her teeth to maintain the demonic path mist's stability, veins on the back of her hand bulging violently—she had clearly reached her limit. Yet at this moment, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul wore a relieved smile: 'Success. The three Lock Keys activated simultaneously, bloodline resonance perfectly achieved—Chen Ji, do you sense it?'"

choice.prompt: "Bloodline resonance is complete, and Chen Ji faces another choice: immediately attempt to use the Tianji Record to foresee the future and test the interference capability of the Heavenly Fate Lock Keys, or first stabilize the resonant connection among the three?"

choices.description: "Immediately deploy the Tianji Record's foresight ability to verify whether the Heavenly Fate Lock Keys can truly interfere with foresight outcomes."
choices.visible_reward: "First verification of the Heavenly Fate Lock Keys' interference capability, discovering blank zones within Tianji Record foresight"
choices.risk_hint: "The Eye of Heavenly Will may lock onto the three people's location through this foresight"

text.content: "Chen Ji did not hesitate, his consciousness diving deep into the Tianji Record fragment. Golden text flowed before his eyes, visions of the next three hours beginning to emerge—yet at this moment, he froze. Vast expanses of blankness appeared in the visions, as if forcefully erased by some power. Ling Yuan's back was blurred and unclear, the Holy Sect's conspiracy revealed only the tip of the iceberg, even his own thread of fate broken and discontinuous, as if it might dissipate into nothingness at any moment."

choices.description: "First deepen the bloodline connection with Chen Nian and Chen Nian (Chen Year), ensuring the stability and durability of the three-person resonance."
choices.visible_reward: "Emotional bond among the three siblings deepens, resonance stability improves, laying foundation for subsequent actions"
choices.risk_hint: "Ye Qing's demonic path mist may not hold much longer"

dialogue.content: "Brother, you said when we were little that you would always protect me. I waited for you for so, so long..."

text.content: "Chen Nian's tears fell silently, yet within the golden light they transformed into specks of stardust that merged into Chen Ji's brow center. Chen Nian (Chen Year) tightly gripped Chen Ji's shoulder, the force nearly crushing bone: 'Brother, this time let us protect you together.' The consciousness of all three fused completely at this moment, bloodline resonance stability soaring, the Heavenly Fate marks' light growing ever more brilliant. Mo Xiansheng nodded approvingly: 'Excellent. The stronger the foundation, the greater the power you will be able to unleash in the future.'"

"'Blankness... all blankness...' Chen Ji murmured, his voice carrying an incredulous joy. He examined those shattered foresight visions repeatedly, growing more elated with each look. The chess game of fate laid out by the Eye of Heavenly Will had, at this moment, cracked for the first time. Any foresight involving Chen Nian became vague and unclear, and when all three siblings were present, even Chen Ji's own fate was veiled in a layer of mist. What did this mean? It meant he was no longer a puppet dancing on the strings of the Eye of Heavenly Will!"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji, do you understand what this means? The Tianji Record is a piece on the chessboard the Eye of Heavenly Will has placed in this world—its abilities have always been controlled by Heavenly Will. And now, you have found the method to restrain it."

text.content: "Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul became uncharacteristically excited, drifting before Chen Ji, his clouded old eyes actually glistening with tears: 'Throughout history, all seers have been manipulated by the Eye of Heavenly Will in the palm of their hand, not a single person ever escaping. And you, Chen Ji, are the first!' Ye Qing also finally exhaled, her demonic path mist slowly dissipating, supporting herself against the wall as she coughed violently, yet unable to hide the smile at the corner of her lips: 'I knew you never wage battles without certainty.'"

dialogue.content: "So from now on, your foresight is no longer a completely transparent chessboard?"

choice.prompt: "A breakthrough has been achieved, but Chen Ji still faces a choice: continue exploring other abilities of the Heavenly Fate Lock Keys here, or immediately relocate to prevent detection by enemies?"

choices.description: "Strike while the iron is hot, test whether the Heavenly Fate Lock Keys have other hidden abilities, such as interfering with specific types of foresight."
choices.visible_reward: "May discover more uses of the Heavenly Fate Lock Keys"

text.content: "Chen Ji closed his eyes in meditation, once again mobilizing the power of the Tianji Record. This time, he fixed his target on Chen Nian—as expected, all foresight involving her turned to chaos. And when he focused on both Chen Nian and Chen Nian (Chen Year) simultaneously, even the foresight of the surrounding environment began to distort. He abruptly opened his eyes, pupils blazing with brilliant light: 'Not just people, but locations and time can be interfered with! As long as the three siblings are together, I can create an absolute blind spot of fate within the Tianji Record!'"

choices.description: "This place is not safe to linger. Bring the three people and evacuate swiftly, seeking a more secure location."
choices.visible_reward: "Ensure the three siblings' safety, avoid detection by enemies"

text.content: "Chen Ji supported Ye Qing's swaying figure, his gaze sweeping over Chen Nian and Chen Nian (Chen Year). All three nodded simultaneously, the Heavenly Fate marks slowly dimming. Using the Tianji Record fragment as a guide, he tore open a rift in the void: 'Go.' The four entered in formation, disappearing from the stone chamber. A bitter smile curved Ye Qing's lips: 'Next time, can you not ask me to do this hard labor...' Before she finished, she collapsed unconscious."

"The instant the spatial rift closed behind them, Chen Ji suddenly froze in place. It was the sensation of being watched by a predator—cold, sharp, as if penetrating the depths of his soul. He spun around abruptly, and though only emptiness lay before his eyes, he clearly sensed the presence of that gaze. Ling Yuan. The old Sect Master of Tianqing Sect, that nominal protector whose true nature concealed treacherous intentions, that long-standing enemy, was somehow piercing through countless barriers to observe everything that had transpired here."

"Chen Nian sensed her brother's unease. She gently clasped Chen Ji's hand, the warmth of her palm a comforting touch. Chen Nian (Chen Year) also drew close, the bloodline resonance allowing them to perceive each other's intentions without words. The three siblings stood shoulder to shoulder, facing that invisible gaze, their expressions calm. A slight smile curved Chen Ji's lips as he spoke softly: 'It seems our old friend can no longer sit idle.' His voice was not loud, yet it clearly reached everyone present, carrying an unnoticeable killing intent, 'Since you wish to watch, then watch your fill. But I hope after watching, you can still sleep peacefully.'"

"Chen Ji laughed lightly, ruffling Chen Nian's hair, the gesture so gentle it seemed like a different person from moments before: 'Dangerous? If he weren't dangerous, how could he be worthy of being your brother's opponent.' His gaze pierced through space, as if engaging in a distant stare with that watching presence. The Eye of Heavenly Will's chess game had gained another variable from this moment, and Ling Yuan's hidden BOSS manipulations had been thoroughly disrupted by Chen Ji's decisive move. The gears of fate began to reverse, the identities of hunter and hunted quietly swapping."
